linkedin:
> Inventory every Railway service in your project (app, workers, databases, cron), your variables, and any volumes holding data.

Create the equivalents on Kloudbean: one always-on server running your app and workers under PM2, plus managed PostgreSQL and Redis. Export variables with `railway variables`, dump your database with `pg_dump` using Railway's public connection URL, restore into the managed database, verify on the temporary URL, then cut DNS over in a quiet window and keep Railway up briefly for rollback.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/migrate-railway-to-kloudbean/
